relationship_to_v0_6_1.prior_question: Can the 201-edge graph estimate the trait-vs-family variance ratio precisely enough to classify trait-dominant vs lineage-dominant architecture?
relationship_to_v0_6_1.prior_hold_reason: Directional recovery passed but median absolute log variance-ratio error exceeded the frozen 0.35 threshold.
relationship_to_v0_6_1.new_question_independent: Can the graph detect a nonzero, practically meaningful repeatable memory component on the trait axis and/or family axis separately?

biological_question: Does phylogenetic memory-loss show repeatable structure associated with trait identity, family identity, both, or neither?

benchmark_scale.rationale: A component SD sqrt(0.005)=0.0707 on the rho scale is half the predeclared 0.15 benchmark effect and is fixed without observing real rho.

component_detection.estimator: REML variance component from the identical crossed random-intercept model
component_detection.rule: component detected iff fitted variance >=0.001 in a nonsingular/converged fit
component_detection.rationale: Threshold is 20% of the practical 0.005 component and is frozen before real rho.

decision_if_pass: A separate repeatability-presence study may open real rho. It may classify trait-associated repeatability present/absent and family-associated repeatability present/absent, but may not compare which variance is larger.
decision_if_hold: Stop before real rho. Do not weaken component size, detection threshold, sensitivity, or false-positive criteria.
